scripts.build: claude plugin validate . && for p in plugins/*/; do claude plugin validate "$p" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');let n=0;const walk=d=>{for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const f=p.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory()){if(e.name!=='node_modules')walk(f)}else if(f.endsWith('.json')){JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'));n++}}};walk('plugins');console.log(n+' JSON files parse')"
